newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN INSTITUTES SEE DOLLAR AVG 1.80 DM IN 1998.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN INSTITUTES SEE DOLLAR AVG 1.80 DM IN 1998.

text.p: Germany's six leading economic research institutes said on Tuesday they see the dollar averaging 1.80 marks in 1998.
"The mark will weaken slightly further against the U.S. dollar," the institutes said in a semiannual report. "On average in 1998 the dollar rate will be 1.80 marks," the report said.
Within the European Union, currency relations will show no significant change this year and next, it said.
These assumptions, along with stable oil prices and interest rates, lie at the basis of the report's other forecasts, it said. -- Bonn newsroom, 49-228-26097150
